25. Manual vs automated testing
Manual testing uses human interaction; automated testing uses scripts or tools to repeat checks.
Manual testing එක tester JකJනක් කරනවා. Automation එක script එJකන් repeat කරනවා.
Exploratory testing වලට human judgment වැදගත්.
Explore usability manually; automate stable checkout regression cases.
